theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Follow the system appearance or use a fixed light or dark theme.

language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by the application.

always_on_top.label: Always on top
always_on_top.description: Keep the model window above other windows.

click_through.label: Click-through overlay
click_through.description: Let pointer input pass through the model window.

keep_inside_work_area.label: Keep inside work area
keep_inside_work_area.description: Keep the overlay clear of taskbars, menu bars and screen edges.

motion_audio.label: Motion audio
motion_audio.description: Play audio attached to model motions.

scale.label: Window scale
scale.description: Resize the model window from 25% to 400%.

opacity.label: Window opacity
opacity.description: Adjust the model window opacity from 1% to 100%.

maximum_fps.label: Maximum FPS
maximum_fps.description: Limit animation and overlay updates from 15 to 240 FPS.

release_fallback_timeout.label: Key release fallback (ms)
release_fallback_timeout.description: Release a captured keyboard key only if normal release and reconciliation both fail. Set to 0 to disable.

runtime.title: Runtime status
runtime.description: Current runtime connection and configuration revision.

behavior_shortcuts.label: Model behavior shortcuts
behavior_shortcuts.description: Allow global shortcuts to trigger motions and expressions.

mirror_pointer_tracking.label: Mirror pointer tracking
mirror_pointer_tracking.description: Mirror horizontal pointer movement with the model.

ignore_pointer_input.label: Ignore pointer input
ignore_pointer_input.description: Do not apply pointer movement to the model.

status_icon.label: Show status icon
status_icon.description: Show the application in the system tray or menu bar.

taskbar_icon.label: Show taskbar icon
taskbar_icon.description: Show the settings window in the Windows taskbar.

auto_update.label: Check for updates automatically
auto_update.description: Check for a new signed release when the application starts and every 24 hours.

startup.disabled: Open the application when you sign in
startup.enabled: The application opens when you sign in
